主要内容: Sun Life Financial Inc. ("Sun Life Financial") (TSX: SLF) (NYSE: SLF) has completed the acquisition of Prime Advisors, Inc. ("Prime") based in Redmond, Washington. The deal was announced on June 30, 2015, and marks a strategic move to enhance Sun Life Investment Management's U.S. institutional investment business. Prime, founded in 1988, had approximately US$13 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2015. It specializes in managing fixed income portfolios for U.S.-based insurance companies, particularly in the property and casualty, health, and life industries. Prime will continue to operate as a standalone unit but will also be integrated into the Sun Life Investment Management platform. Steve Peacher, President of Sun Life Investment Management, emphasized that the acquisition strengthens the firm's offerings in the U.S. market. Don McDonald, President and CEO of Prime Advisors, noted that the transaction positions the company for accelerated growth in creating integrated investment strategies for clients. Sun Life Financial has completed the acquisition of U.S.-based investment manager Prime Advisors, Inc. This move is part of Sun Life Financial's strategy to expand its investment management capabilities. Prime Advisors, Inc., based in Redmond, Washington, and Windsor, Connecticut, is a federally registered investment advisory firm that focuses on managing investment grade bond portfolios for the insurance industry. The acquisition is expected to enhance Sun Life Financial's ability to develop customized solutions for its clients. Sun Life Financial, which celebrated its 150th anniversary in 2015, operates in multiple global markets and had total assets under management of $813 billion as of March 31, 2015. The company trades on the Toronto (TSX), New York (NYSE), and Philippine (PSE) stock exchanges under the ticker symbol SLF.
